description: A 128x64 source — red on its left half, blue on its right — in a 64x64 raster, with `fit: fill`. Filling scales it to cover the raster and crops the overflow off the sides, so the reference is the middle of the source: red on the left half of the frame, blue on the right. Fitting it instead would letterbox the whole 2:1 source into a band with transparent above and below, which over the black canvas reads as bars — the failure this fixture exists to catch. Cropping from the wrong place, or stretching to fill, both move the seam off centre.
